# Provenance: physical

Hand-written fixture, not copied from upstream.

- `Shop MK4.ini`: modelled on a 2.9 physical printer file (header-less `key = value`, the `PhysicalPrinter::printer_options()` keys of PrusaSlicer-2.9@b028299:src/libslic3r/Preset.cpp:1760-1772; AGPL-3.0). The host is a documentation address (192.0.2.10) and the API key `FAKE-KEY-DO-NOT-USE-0000` is made up. Written for this repository, AGPL-3.0-or-later.
